items.title: Origin Private File System
items.blurb: The origin private file system (OPFS) is a storage endpoint provided as part of the File System API, which is private to the origin of the page and not visible to the user like the regular file system.

items.title: Persistent Databases in the Browser with DuckDB-Wasm and OPFS
